provenance.encodes: The Indigo Book, T2 Department of Commerce, Patent and Trademark Office (Trademark applications)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book (https://law.resource.org/pub/us/code/blue/IndigoBook.html, CC0), T2 Department of Commerce, Patent and Trademark Office (Trademark applications), and compare the form and examples with this pattern.

positive.text: U.S. Trademark Application Serial No. 86,680,743 (filed Jul. 1, 2015).
See U.S. Trademark Application Serial No. 87,123,456 (filed Aug. 2, 2016).
Compare Application Serial No. 88/123,456 with Application Serial No. 90,000,001.
The examining attorney refused Serial No. 87123456.
Compare Ser. No. 90123456 with Application No. 97/654,321.

negative: The application serial number was lost.

note: Merged from two branches: Indigo T2 (Application Serial No. 86,680,743) and TMEP/TBMP forms (Serial No. 87123456, Ser. No., Application No. 97/654,321; not opened). A bare `Serial No.` takes only USPTO's compact or slash number, never the comma-grouped `86,680,743` (reject), which is too common for product serial numbers. Series codes start 7-9.
